subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if so should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, `cli.tui.deliver`, or a non-config TUI preference?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally make delivery an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve a canonical config key
options.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as highest-precedence overrides.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and document that decision before closing or retitling the request.

options.title: Use an in-product preference
options.body: Reject a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted setting if maintainers want per-user or per-session behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve a canonical config key
recommendation.body: Add a narrow boolean config default with schema/help/docs/tests, while keeping explicit CLI flags as highest-precedence overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about TUI UX and OpenClaw config/default policy, and this owner signal introduced the relevant TUI surface.
